title: Dynamics of Hidden Learning Structure
abstract: arXiv:2610.29054v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A learner's present predictions do not fully determine how it will learn next. We study the dynamics of hidden learning structure through two related operations. Fiber Regulation Theory (FRT) describes protected repair of existing function and the learning responses left available after repair. Fiber Acquisition Theory (FAT) describes the formation and renewal of trainable structure, distinguishing neutral installation, access to a learning signal, and additional functional directions. The two operations also constrain one another. A repair obligation can force a change in a learning channel, while acquired features can make new protected repairs feasible or reduce the minimum coefficient cost of existing ones. We characterize joint admissibility and response reachability, and give a finite supervised-learning construction in which the two operations together produce a favorable response absent from either operation alone. translated_title: 隐藏学习结构的动力学
translated_abstract: 学习者当前的预测并不能完全决定其接下来将如何学习。我们通过两个相互关联的操作来研究隐藏学习结构的动力学。纤维调节理论描述了对现有功能的保护性修复，以及修复之后仍然可用的学习响应。纤维获取理论描述了可训练结构的形成与更新，并区分了中性安装、对学习信号的访问以及额外的功能方向。这两种操作还会相互约束：一项修复义务可能迫使某个学习通道发生改变，而新获取的特征既可能使新的保护性修复变得可行，也可能降低现有修复的最小系数成本。我们刻画了联合可容许性与响应可达性，并给出了一个有限监督学习构造，其中这两种操作结合在一起能够产生一种仅靠任一单独操作都无法实现的有利响应。我们实现了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出纤维调节理论与纤维获取理论，刻画了隐藏学习结构中“保护性修复”与“可训练结构获取”这两种操作及其相互约束关系，并通过有限监督学习构造证明二者联合可产生任一操作单独无法实现的有利学习响应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Fiber Regulation Theory and Fiber Acquisition Theory to characterize the dynamics of hidden learning structures, showing that protected repair and trainable-structure acquisition mutually constrain each other and, when combined, can produce favorable learning responses unattainable by either operation alone.
